ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムユニコーン』劇場公開を記念して、
ユニコーンガンダムの限定アイテムが‘ホビーオンラインショップ’に登場！
劇中に登場のＭ.Ｓ.を揃えて、ユニコーンの世界観を堪能しよう！
劇中登場のジムIIIの形状＆カラーを完全再現！！
●膝部、背面腰部／足首、シールド外装は新規パーツで、劇中登場の形状を徹底訴求
●劇中イメージの特徴的なデザートカラーを成形色で再現
●自由度の高い可動域で、射撃ポーズも動きのあるポーズで再現可能
１／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：８才以上
製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ
・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません

en: To commemorate the theatrical release of "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn",
Unicorn Gundam limited items are now available at the ‘Hobby Online Shop’!
Get the MS that appears in the movie and enjoy the world of unicorns!
Completely reproduces the shape and color of Jim III that appears in the movie! !
-The knees, back waist/ankles, and Seal exterior are new parts, thoroughly appealing to the shape that appears in the play.
-Reproduce the characteristic dessert color of the image in the play with molded color
-With a high degree of freedom of movement, shooting poses can be reproduced in dynamic poses.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a painted prototype. The actual product may differ slightly.
(remarks)
・This product is a limited edition item.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
